Prince's room: his surface, as this photo sees it

Centimetres; floor grid 2 cm. +X his left, +Y up, +Z his forward; origin on the surface he sits on, under the middle of his peets.

Every point is one pixel of him: the ray from the camera through that pixel, cut at the distance a depth model measured, coloured as the photo. Nothing invented: no smoothing, no filling, nothing he does not show in this photo. Each model keeps its own camera (its own lens and distance). One number per model sets the units so he is 15.5 cm wide (approved). Up: the camera at his eye level, a tiny bit lower (as remembered). Not a model of him.

His outermost 4 px blend into the removed background, so their distances are least sure. In the camera's view the photo is hidden: what you see is his measured surface, every point on its own pixel.

The room's camera for this photo is MoGe-2's. Its rays through his outline (coloured by part), his landmarks and his part lines, and how he faces, are all worked out from it. His size: 15.5 cm wide (approved), 16.64 cm to the top of his head, ear tips 17.95 cm, eyes 13.45, nose 9.5. (The six-inch camera first remembered is kept in data/cameras.json as a superseded record.)
